Excellent! **Rd5+** is the clearly best move. It forces Black's king away with check, and after any king move, White plays Rxh4, winning the rook outright. The key is that the king move is forced, so White gets time to capture the undefended rook.

**Best move:** Rd5+

**Main line:** Rd5+ Kg6 Rxh4 (or after Kg4 Rxh4+ with the same material gain)

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent's rook is undefended and attacking one of yours, look for a forcing move—a check—that drives the king away. Here, Rd5+ forced Black's king to move, giving White time to capture the hanging rook on h4. Don't just react to threats; use a check to create your own tempo and win material.
